svg.desc: Paid for by the Source, Reference: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $401,593 to $1,641,066; at the main row, $442,654 (seed interval $440,257 to $445,128). Paid for by the Source, Adverse: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $305,594 to $1,509,132; at the main row, $388,827 (seed interval $386,507 to $391,026). Paid for by the Source, Stress: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $259,197 to $1,249,733; at the main row, $330,711 (seed interval $328,597 to $332,906). Paid for by a contribution, Reference: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-428,855 to $454,908; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($-6,252; materiality $20,114) (seed interval $-8,568 to $-4,086). Paid for by a contribution, Adverse: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-169,880 to $393,237; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($12,151; materiality $13,704) (seed interval $9,571 to $14,645). Paid for by a contribution, Stress: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-162,316 to $333,309; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($7,647; materiality $13,704) (seed interval $5,154 to $10,088).
svg.title: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the C2.2 design against no programme, 40 years
svg.text: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the C2.2 design against no programme, 40 years
Each dot is one preregistered reading, sorted by its effect, with its 95% seed interval (unit: $).
Ringed: the main row. Diamond: the least-favourable bound. Shaded: not material (rule 3). Below each panel: the curve's verdict (rule 2).
Paid for by the Source (main row: full backing, a design parameter)
